Set up directories
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library("here")
dir <- setwd(here())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Mac/Dropbox/Desktop/ESS_restructured/")
# Define the save directory
save_dir <- paste0(here(), "/Ess_Output/")
```


You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(factoextra)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(FactoMineR)
library(plotly)
```
 Load and Clean
```{r}
long_df <- read.csv("Ess_data/ESS q-adj data for Ezekiel 1970-2022.csv") |>
  filter(SPECIES < 800, YEAR >= 1978,YEAR <= 2022) |>
  filter(!is.na(SPECIES_NAME),
         !grepl("INCL |snail|unidentified|GADOIDEI|unid.|S.O.",
                SPECIES_NAME, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  filter(!SPECIES_NAME %in% c(
    "INCL SHARK & CHONDRICHTHYES; SHARK",
    "SAND LANCES",
    "SKATES",
    "EELPOUTS" )) |>
  rename(Year = YEAR, Species = SPECIES_NAME)
```

Create Matrix as recommended
```{r}
long_wide <- long_df |>
  group_by(Year, Species) |>
  summarise(Biomass = sum(BIOMASS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species,
              values_from = Biomass,
              values_fill = 0)

write.csv(long_wide, "Ess_data/PCA.csv", row.names = FALSE)
pl.data <- read.table("Ess_data/PCA.csv",
                      sep = ",",header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
```


RunPCA
```{r}
res.pca <- prcomp(pl.data,center = TRUE,scale. = TRUE)
# Variance explained
PoV <- res.pca$sdev^2 / sum(res.pca$sdev^2)
print(fviz_eig(res.pca))
#PCA score
scores <- as.data.frame(res.pca$x)
scores$Year <- rownames(pl.data)
# PCA plot
ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, label = Year)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "PCA of Fish Community Biomass",
         x = "PC1",
         y = "PC2")
# PCA Individuals
fviz_pca_ind(res.pca,
               col.ind = "contrib",gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),repel = TRUE)
# PCA Variables             

  fviz_pca_var(res.pca,
               col.var = "contrib",
               gradient.cols = c("#36648B", "#FFA500", "#8B2500"),
               repel = TRUE)

```

# 3D PCA
```{r}
pcx <- res.pca$x[,1]
pcy <- res.pca$x[,2]

df2D <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcx,
  PC2 = pcy,
  Year = rownames(res.pca$x))

# Interactive plotly 2D
fig <- plot_ly(df2D,
               x = ~PC1,
               y = ~PC2,
               type = "scatter",
               mode = "markers+lines",
               text = ~Year,
               color = ~PC2) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(PoV[1]*100, 2), "%)")),
    yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(PoV[2]*100, 2), "%)")) )

fig

# Static base R 2D
cols <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "yellow", "red"))(length(pcy))

plot(pcx, pcy,
     pch = 19,
     col = cols,
     cex = 1.5,
     main = "PCA Scores (2D)",
     xlab = paste0("PC1 (", round(PoV[1]*100, 2), "%)"),
     ylab = paste0("PC2 (", round(PoV[2]*100, 2), "%)"))

text(pcx, pcy,
     labels = rownames(res.pca$x),
     cex = 0.7,
     pos = 3)

```

Cluster plot
```{r}
# =========================
# 1. LIBRARIES
# =========================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(factoextra)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. LOAD & CLEAN DATA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
long_df <- read.csv("Ess_data/ESS q-adj data for Ezekiel 1970-2022.csv") |>
  filter(SPECIES < 1000, YEAR >= 1978, YEAR <= 2022) |>
  filter(!is.na(SPECIES_NAME),
         !grepl("INCL |snail|unidentified|GADOIDEI|unid.|S.O.",
                SPECIES_NAME, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  filter(!SPECIES_NAME %in% c(
    "INCL SHARK & CHONDRICHTHYES; SHARK",
    "SAND LANCES", "SKATES", "EELPOUTS")) |>
  rename(Year = YEAR, Species = SPECIES_NAME)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. COMMUNITY MATRIX
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
long_wide <- long_df |>
  group_by(Year, Species) |>
  summarise(Biomass = sum(BIOMASS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Biomass, values_fill = 0)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. PREPARE MATRIX
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
years <- long_wide$Year
pl.data <- long_wide |> select(-Year)
pl.data <- as.data.frame(lapply(pl.data, as.numeric))
rownames(pl.data) <- years

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. PCA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
res.pca <- prcomp(pl.data, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
PoV <- res.pca$sdev^2 / sum(res.pca$sdev^2)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. PCA SCORES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
scores <- as.data.frame(res.pca$x)
scores$Year <- years

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. HIERARCHICAL CLUSTERING ON PC1-PC3
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
pca_scores_3 <- res.pca$x[, 1:3]           # extract first 3 PCs
dist_mat <- dist(pca_scores_3)              # Euclidean distance on PC1-PC3
hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "ward.D2")
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = 3)
scores$Cluster <- as.factor(clusters)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7. CLUSTER PLOT
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = Cluster), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Year), size = 3, max.overlaps = 50) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(PoV[1] * 100, 1), "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(PoV[2] * 100, 1), "% variance)"),
    color = "Cluster",
    fill = "Cluster"
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")

# Good subtitle 
# Figure X. Clustered PCA ordination of fish community biomass (1978–2022).
```

Hierarchical clustering on PCA (HCPC)
```{r}
res.pca4 <- FactoMineR::PCA(pl.data,ncp = 3,graph = FALSE)

res.hcpc <- FactoMineR::HCPC(res.pca4, graph = FALSE)
# Dendrogram

fviz_dend(res.hcpc,
            cex = 0.7,
            palette = "jco",
            rect = TRUE,
            rect_fill = TRUE,
            rect_border = "jco",
            labels_track_height = 0.8)

#Cluster Map
fviz_cluster(res.hcpc,
               repel = TRUE,
               show.clust.cent = TRUE,
               palette = "jco",
               ggtheme = theme_bw(),
               main = "Factor Map")
# Proportion of Variance
PoV <- res.pca$sdev^2 / sum(res.pca$sdev^2)
#Extract PCA scores (FIXED)
pcx <- res.pca$x[,1]
pcy <- res.pca$x[,2]
pcz <- res.pca$x[,3]

#Axis labels
pcxlab <- paste0("PC1 (", round(PoV[1] * 100, 2), "%)")
pcylab <- paste0("PC2 (", round(PoV[2] * 100, 2), "%)")
pczlab <- paste0("PC3 (", round(PoV[3] * 100, 2), "%)")


#3D scatter (plot3D)

#2D connected trajectory
cols <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "yellow", "red"))(length(pcx))

plot(pcx, pcy,
     type = "b",
     pch = 20,
     cex = 1.5,
     col = cols,
     lwd = 2,
     xlab = pcxlab,
     ylab = pcylab,
     main = "PCA Trajectory (PC1 vs PC2)")
text(pcx, pcy,
     labels = rownames(res.pca$x),
     pos = 3,
     cex = 0.7)
```


CORRECTED RAINBOW + PLOTLY SECTION (COMBINED)
```{r}

# DATA FRAME FOR 2D PLOT
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

df <- data.frame(comp1 = pcx, comp2 = pcy,Year = rownames(res.pca$x))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# RAINBOW PCA (2D trajectory)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

print(
  ggplot(df, aes(x = comp1, y = comp2, group = 1)) +
    geom_path(linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 5, aes(colour = Year)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Year), size = 3, vjust = -0.5) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(title = "PCA Trajectory (2D)"))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3D DATA FRAME
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

df3D <- data.frame(
  comp1 = pcx,
  comp2 = pcy,
  comp3 = pcz,
  Year = rownames(res.pca$x))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# PLOTLY 3D PCA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

fig <- plot_ly(df3D,
               x = ~comp1,
               y = ~comp2,
               z = ~comp3,
               type = "scatter3d",
               mode = "markers+lines",
               text = ~Year,
               color = ~comp3)

fig <- fig %>%
  add_markers() %>%
  add_text(textposition = "top right") %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = pcxlab),
      yaxis = list(title = pcylab),
      zaxis = list(title = pczlab)),
    annotations = list(
      x = 1.13,
      y = 1.05,
      text = "PC3 Score",
      showarrow = FALSE
    ))

fig
```


#DENDROGRAMS ###############################
```{r}
#install.packages("ape")   # if needed
library(ape)
################################# DENDROGRAMS ###############################
# Dendrogram flowing down the page
dd <- dist(scale(pl.data), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc, hang = -1, cex = 0.3)   # Put the labels at the same height: hang = -1
plot(hc, hang = -1, cex = 1.5)   # Put the labels at the same height: hang = -1

# Dendrogram flowing across the page
# Define nodePar
hcd <- as.dendrogram(hc)
nodePar <- list(lab.cex = 0.6, pch = c(NA, 19),  cex = 0.7, col = "blue")
par(cex=0.5)   # Customized plot; remove labels
par(cex=1.0)   # Customized plot; remove labels
plot(hcd,  xlab = "Height", nodePar = nodePar, horiz = TRUE)

# Unrooted - dendrogram on an arc
plot(as.phylo(hc), type = "unrooted", cex = 0.6, no.margin = TRUE)

# Fan
par(cex=0.3)
par(cex=1.0)
plot(as.phylo(hc), type = "fan")
colors = c("red", "blue", "green", "black", "yellow", "purple", "grey", "brown", "magenta", "cyan", "violetred", "tomato")
clus = cutree(hc, 12)
plot(as.phylo(hc), type = "fan", tip.color = colors[clus],label.offset = 1, cex = 0.3)
plot(as.phylo(hc), type = "fan", tip.color = colors[clus],label.offset = 1, cex = 1.0)



```

########################### CORRELATION RESULTS ###########################  
```{r}
############################
# LOAD PACKAGES
############################
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)
library(RColorBrewer)

############################
# LOAD DATA
############################
pl.data <- read.csv("Ess_data/PCA.csv")

# Keep Year separately (important for interpretation)
rownames(pl.data) <- pl.data$Year
pl.data$Year <- NULL

############################
# KEEP ONLY NUMERIC DATA
############################
pl.data.numeric <- pl.data %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

# Remove zero-variance columns (critical for PCA/correlation stability)
variances <- apply(pl.data.numeric, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
pl.data.clean <- pl.data.numeric[, variances > 0]

############################
# OPTIONAL: REDUCE DIMENSION FOR READABILITY
# (THIS FIXES YOUR OVERCROWDED PLOT)
############################

# Keep only top 25 most variable columns (recommended for corrplot)
top_vars <- names(sort(variances, decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(25, length(variances))]
pl.data.clean <- pl.data.clean[, top_vars]

############################
# CORRELATION MATRIX
############################
M <- cor(pl.data.clean,
         method = "spearman",
         use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# Proper NA handling (your previous method was incorrect)
M[is.na(M)] <- 0

############################
# PLOT CORRELATION MATRIX (FIXED)
############################

############################
# OPTIONAL: SAVE HIGH-QUALITY OUTPUT
############################
#png("corrplot_clean.png", width = 3000, height = 2500, res = 300)
corrplot(
  M,
  type = "upper",
  order = "hclust",
  method = "color",
  col = brewer.pal(8, "RdYlBu"),
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.cex = 0.5,
  tl.srt = 45,
  diag = FALSE
)

```

Heatmap of contribution to biomass of all species
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(heatmaply)
library(RColorBrewer)

filename <- "Ess_data/PCA.csv"

# Read data
pl.data <- read.csv(filename, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

# Set row names (Year)
rownames(pl.data) <- pl.data[, 1]

# Remove Year column
SP_as_colA <- pl.data %>% dplyr::select(-1)

# Ensure numeric
SP_as_colA <- as.data.frame(lapply(SP_as_colA, as.numeric))
rownames(SP_as_colA) <- rownames(pl.data)

# Transpose: species x years
Yr_as_col <- t(as.matrix(SP_as_colA))

# Replace NA
Yr_as_col[is.na(Yr_as_col)] <- 0

# Filter rare species (present in at least 5 years)
keep <- rowSums(Yr_as_col > 0) >= 5
Yr_as_col <- Yr_as_col[keep, ]

# Rank within each species (row-wise)
drRanked <- t(apply(Yr_as_col, 1, function(i) {
  data.table::frank(i, ties.method = "dense")
}))
drRanked <- as.data.frame(drRanked)
colnames(drRanked) <- colnames(Yr_as_col)
rownames(drRanked) <- rownames(Yr_as_col)

# Heatmap
HeatmapTitle <- "Heatmap of ranked biomass contribution through time"
jpeg("heatmap.tiff", width = 22, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
pheatmap(
  drRanked,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = F,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  fontsize_col = 7,
   cellwidth = 16,
  #cellheight =12,
 color = colorRampPalette(c("#2C7BB6","#ABD9E9","#FFFFBF","#FDAE61","#D7191C"))(100),
  #main = HeatmapTitle,
  xlab = "Year",
  border_color = NA
)
dev.off()


tiff("heatmap.tiffhhhh", width = 12, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300)
pheatmap(
  drRanked,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  fontsize_col = 7,
  cellwidth = 16,
  #cellheight = 12,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2C7BB6","#ABD9E9","#FFFFBF","#FDAE61","#D7191C"))(100),
  xlab = "Year",
  border_color = NA,
  margins = c(5, 8)  # bottom, right margins
)
dev.off()

```


#Heatmap of contribution to biomass of all species that contribut 95% and above
# Species that together account for 95% of the total biomass across all years.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
pl.data <- read.csv(filename)
rownames(pl.data) <- pl.data$Year
pl.data <- pl.data %>% select(-Year)
pl.data[is.na(pl.data)] <- 0

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. RELATIVE BIOMASS (within each year)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
rel_biomass <- sweep(pl.data, 1, rowSums(pl.data), FUN = "/")
rel_biomass[is.na(rel_biomass)] <- 0

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. MEAN CONTRIBUTION ACROSS YEARS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
mean_contrib <- colMeans(rel_biomass)
mean_contrib <- sort(mean_contrib, decreasing = TRUE)
cum_contrib  <- cumsum(mean_contrib)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. SELECT SPECIES (top 95% of biomass)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
threshold    <- 0.95
keep_species <- names(cum_contrib[cum_contrib <= threshold])
keep_species <- unique(c(
  keep_species,
  names(cum_contrib)[which(cum_contrib > threshold)[1]]
))
mat_filtered <- rel_biomass[, keep_species, drop = FALSE]
mat_filtered <- mat_filtered[, order(colMeans(mat_filtered), decreasing = TRUE)]

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. ENSURE YEAR ORDER (1978 → 2022)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
mat_filtered <- mat_filtered[order(as.numeric(rownames(mat_filtered))), ]

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. TRANSPOSE & FIX COLUMN ORDER
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
mat_t <- t(mat_filtered)

# Prefix year colnames so pheatmap treats them as strings not numbers
colnames(mat_t) <- paste0("y", colnames(mat_t))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7. HEATMAP
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
library(ggplotify)

p <- as.ggplot(pheatmap(
  mat_t,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  fontsize_row = 7,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  angle_col = 90,
  border_color = NA,
  cellwidth = 11,
  cellheight = 11,
  labels_col = gsub("y", "", colnames(mat_t)),
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2C7BB6","#ABD9E9","#FFFFBF","#FDAE61","#D7191C"))(100),
  silent = TRUE
))

ggsave("heatmap.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 13,
       height = 5,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 1000,
       limitsize = FALSE)
#  Species that together account for 95% of the total biomass across all years.

# The PCA was conducted using annual fish species biomass as variables, where each species represented one variable and each year (1978–2022) was an observation.


```
